findings.message: False cross-reference to Unit 2's content (sources). topic-01.mdx:107-110: 'The two schools of Unit 2's Nawabshah scene - one with functioning fans and clean water, one without - differ in hygiene.' Unit 2's Nawabshah scene (unit-02/topic-02.mdx:26-38; also unit-02/unit-assessment.mdx:146-150) is a physical-development contrast (height/weight, 'food' vs 'breeding', blackboard height, water buckets); no fans or clean-water contrast exists anywhere in unit-02. The spec's worked-example plan (content-spec.md:813-814) lists the two-schools example without the Unit 2 attribution. Repair: describe Unit 2's scene accurately or present the two-schools example as this unit's own; then re-prepare the manifest for a fresh reviewer.

Misquote of the OpenStax source (sources). topic-01.mdx:76-77 quotes 'reaching one's full potential' to (Spielman, Jenkins & Lovett, 2020); the live page (fetched 2026-09-25) says 'achieving one's full potential' and contains no 'reaching'. The bound excerpt carries the same wrong quote (sources/texts/spielman2020.md:96-97). Repair: correct the wording in both.

Pronoun altered inside quotation marks (sources). topic-01.mdx:53-55 quotes 'because of the sense of personal satisfaction that it brings'; the source says 'they bring' (of behaviours). Repair: use '[it]' or move the gloss outside the quotation.

Deficit/growth gloss goes beyond the cited source (sources). topic-01.mdx:77-80 glosses deficit needs as 'the lower four' and growth needs as 'the top' of the five-level hierarchy under a (Seifert & Sutton, 2009) citation. The precedence claim is verbatim in Seifert Ch. 6 (p.125), but Seifert's own Table 8 (Ch. 3, p.54) uses a six-need scheme (deficit: physiological, safety, love/belonging, cognitive; being: aesthetic, self-actualization) and does not assign esteem to the deficit set. The mapping is standard Maslow but is this unit's synthesis. Repair: attribute the mapping honestly or cite a source that carries it.

Teacher-notes overstatement of the guide (authority). unit-teacher-notes.mdx:83-86: 'The guide's practical component for this chapter is an individual assignment: each trainee records, verbatim, four or five sentences...' The guide's Practical Work list is course-generic (Hands-on Computer Exercises, Individual Assignments, Group Assignments, Presentations, Internet-Research tasks; 1st 2026.txt:1183-1189); the recording task is this unit's own design. Same class as Unit 5 round-1 advisory 7. Repair: rephrase to 'the guide's practical-work menu includes individual assignments; this unit uses one'.

Unsupported coverage reinforcement row (coverage). coverage/unit-06.md:24 maps U6-6 (emotions in learning) to topic-02.mdx 'The attribution loop' with source seifert2009, but that section (topic-02.mdx:64-90) contains no emotions content; emotion material appears only from :92. The row likely means U6-5. Repair: correct the row or point it at a section that actually revisits emotions.
